ui.guide.title: How do I? Steps for this screen
ui.guide.source:
Open OneNote desktop (the app, not the browser) and check that the notebook is listed there, on the left.
Press “Check the OneNote connection”. Every row should show ✓. Where there is ✗, the line below says what to do. Fix it and press again.
Press “Show notebooks” and tick the notebook, sections or pages. For a team notebook you can paste its browser link below and press “Find the notebook”.
Name the extraction (for example “team”) and press “Extract”. Extraction only reads from OneNote: nothing changes.
When “Done: … pages” appears, continue with “Analysis”.
Without OneNote: tick “Fictional sample” and follow the same steps on made-up data.
A wrong extraction (for example “demo”) is removed under “Existing extractions” → “Delete”. Only the data on this computer is deleted.
ui.guide.analysis:
At the top, under “Data”, choose the extraction to check.
Keep the threshold at 0.60 the first time. “Groups per threshold” shows what changes if you move it: higher = stricter groups.
Press “Run analysis”. It takes a few seconds.
Continue with “Groups”.
ui.guide.groups:
On the left are the groups: pages describing the same procedure, most serious first.
Choose a group. On the right you see the findings (different values, missing steps, probably outdated pages) and the pages side by side, with the differences highlighted.
Under each page choose a decision: Reference (the good version), Outdated, Archive, Move… (to another section, picked from a list), Leave as is or Not in group.
Shortcuts: J / K next / previous group, 1–9 choose the page, R / O / A / I decide.
Decisions change nothing in OneNote. Those to apply appear under “To apply”. The report (HTML, CSV for Excel, Markdown) is downloaded from here.
ui.guide.apply:
Decisions that change something in OneNote (Archive, Move, Outdated) appear here, with an exact preview of the change.
Writing is off by default. Try it on the test notebook first, not on the real one.
To apply: “Settings” → tick “Allow writing to OneNote” → “Save”, then come back here.
Tick the decisions and press “Apply”. A backup of each page is saved first.
Afterwards turn writing off again in “Settings”. Anything applied can be undone in “Archive and log” → “Restore”.
ui.guide.journal:
Top: pages changed in OneNote. “Restore” brings them back as they were.
Bottom: all decisions, with the date. “Undo” works as long as the decision has not been applied.
ui.guide.settings:
Default threshold, archive section name, prefix for outdated pages and sections excluded from extraction.
“Allow writing to OneNote” is off by default. Turn it on only to apply decisions, then off again.
Press “Save” after each change.
“Reset settings” brings everything back to the install defaults. Extractions stay.
At the bottom, “Technical log” shows what DocAudit did and what failed. A copy goes to Google Drive (DocAudit's “logs” folder), without page content, so it can be read remotely.

diag.pywin32.fix: Run Install.bat again from the DocAudit folder (it installs pywin32), quit DocAudit from the icon next to the clock and start it again.
diag.registry.fix: Install OneNote from Microsoft 365 (the desktop app, not “OneNote for Windows 10”), start it once, then check again.
diag.com.fix: Start OneNote desktop and close any dialog open in it. If the text mentions gen_py, delete the folder %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\gen_py. Check again. If it still fails, send me the text above.
diag.notebooks.fix: In OneNote desktop: File → Open and choose the notebook, or in OneNote on the web “Open in Desktop App”. Wait for it to sync, then check again.

ui.guide.bot:
Run „Analysis” and make your decisions in „Groups” first: archived and outdated pages and exact duplicates are left out of the documents.
Choose how documents are split (one PDF per notebook, per top folder or per section) and the bot limit (95 MB by default; the bot accepts at most 100 MB per file).
Check the list: untick pages that must not reach the bot, or tick a page that was left out.
Press „Export”. Each page becomes a PDF through OneNote (files on disk only, OneNote is not changed); pages unchanged since last time are reused.
Then upload to the bot only the files under „To re-upload” (including 00_Cuprins.pdf, the index with the latest changes). If the bot instructions changed, copy them into the bot configuration. Export the pages under „Check by hand” from OneNote yourself (File → Export → PDF).
